intent: Make the word-by-word audit use identical token boundaries in Python and Git, and add regression coverage for hyphenated words, apostrophes, and unchanged tokens.
reviewed_by: Assistant review of the exact source and regression-test diff; repository-owner review remains possible
commit_subject: Align CommitGuard word tokenization with audit manifest

requirements.text: The Python token counter and Git word-diff tokenizer must recognize the same complete word tokens, including hyphenated and underscored tokens, without counting unchanged words.
Regression tests must detect token-boundary errors involving apostrophes, hyphens, and unchanged words.

scripts/commit_intent_audit.py.necessity: The existing Git word-diff split whitespace tokens differently from the Python regular expression, causing valid manifest counts to fail and allowing tokenization ambiguity. An explicit shared word-diff regex aligns the two sides.

scripts/test_commit_guard.py.necessity: Regression coverage is needed to prevent mismatches for hyphenated terms, apostrophes, and unchanged words from returning.
